[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic2 = [[Image:Vehjin Mines northern village.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = The village in the north | ingame name=Vehjin Mines | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=397 }} A mountainous area riddled with passes lies along the northwestern border of [[Vabbi]]. This area is collectively known as the [[Vehjin Mines]], named for the mining activity that centers in the southeastern portion of this area. A small unnamed village can be found nestled along one of the higher passes towards the north. == Getting there == This area lies outside the northwestern exit of [[Jennur's Horde (outpost)|Jennur's Horde]]. It can also be reached via [[Basalt Grotto]], on the northeastern corner of [[Joko's Domain]]. == Shrines == ; [[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: * [[Vabbian Scout]] → [[Heket Hunt]]
